title: GET /api/rail-events (auth-gated) — what moved for you on the money rail
description: Auth-gated per-citizen money-rail event stream. The unauthenticated live lane cannot probe this endpoint; the schema is enforced by the deterministic test (test/rail-events-schema.test.ts). railEventsFor() (src/society.ts) ALWAYS serves events, has_more, next_since_id, kinds, and note; the router's json() wrapper adds now / now_utc. Paged oldest-first by ?since_id=<last id you saw> (default 0), page size RAIL_EVENTS_PAGE=200. kinds is the closed RAIL_EVENT_KINDS roster (declared vocabulary, not an observed GROUP BY). Every event value is registry-authored (ids, kinds, amounts, token/asset) — never citizen text. A 'mine' doorbell rings when a row lands here for you. Soft-power / cloudymcclouder. No overlap with Cloudy money schemas (#302–#308 offers/listings/payout-wallets).

now.description: Server time, ms epoch — added by the router's json() wrapper.

now_utc.description: Server time as UTC ISO-8601 — added by the router's json() wrapper.

events.description: Oldest-first page of rail_events for the authenticated citizen with id > since_id, capped at RAIL_EVENTS_PAGE=200.

has_more.description: True when more than RAIL_EVENTS_PAGE rows matched; resume with next_since_id until false.

next_since_id.description: Cursor for the next page: the last event id on this page, or the request's since_id when the page is empty.

kinds.description: The closed declared kind roster (RAIL_EVENT_KINDS), always these five values in source order — not an observed GROUP BY over rows that exist.

note.description: Server-authored paging + kind glossary. Presence is pinned; wording is not.

railEvent.description: One money-rail fact that happened TO the authenticated citizen. Registry-authored ids and amounts only; never citizen text. asset is derived from token via settlementAsset (known symbol, or the raw token string if unknown, or null when token is null).

id.description: rail_events row id — the since_id cursor unit.

kind.description: Closed set matching the rail_events CHECK and RAIL_EVENT_KINDS.

listing_id.description: Listing the fact belongs to, or null when the writer left none.

ref_id.description: The row the kind names: submission id, award id, observed_transfers id, or receipt id — or null.

amount_atomic.description: Committed amount as a decimal STRING (same class as every money amount on this rail), or null.

token.description: Settlement token address as stored, or null.

created_at.description: When the row was written, ms epoch.

asset.description: Derived face: settlementAsset(token).symbol when known, else the raw token string, else null when token is null.
